entities.name: Angélique Delahaye
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Angélique Delahaye is a French agricultural trade unionist and politician. She was the president of the Fédération nationale des producteurs de légumes from 2001 to 2012, and a member of the board of directors of the Fédération nationale des syndicats d'exploitants agricoles. She served as a Member of the European Parliament from 2014 to 2019, and was mayor of Saint-Martin-le-Beau from 2014 to 2020.
